# Apple test PKI (TEST ONLY)

Generated by `backend/scripts/gen-apple-test-pki.sh` (prime256v1 root -> intermediate -> leaf, with Apple's custom OIDs).

The leaf private key (`leaf.pk8.pem`) is a TEST-ONLY key. It is never trusted by production code: production trusts only the embedded Apple Root CA G3 (`src/modules/entitlements/apple-root-g3.ts`). The test root (`root.der`) is passed only through the test helper `tests/helpers/apple-test-signer.ts`.
